datasets.name: ds_briefing_lines
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT target_date, planning_area, heat_level, tier, tier_rank, tier_sentence, reason, actions, scored_at
  FROM area_heat_risk WHERE target_date = (SELECT max(target_date) FROM area_heat_risk)
),
d AS (
  SELECT max(target_date) AS target_date, max(scored_at) AS scored_at,
    count_if(tier = 'High') AS n_high, count_if(tier = 'Medium') AS n_medium, count_if(tier = 'Low') AS n_low,
    count_if(tier = 'Not rated') AS n_not_rated, count_if(tier = 'No forecast') AS n_no_forecast,
    count_if(tier = 'Medium' AND heat_level = 'High') AS n_medium_high_heat,
    array_sort(collect_list(CASE WHEN tier = 'Not rated' AND heat_level = 'High' THEN initcap(planning_area) END)) AS nr
  FROM latest
),
today AS (SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'Asia/Singapore')) AS sgt_today)
SELECT line FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS k, concat('Heat risk for ', date_format(target_date, 'EEEE, d MMMM yyyy'), ', prepared ',
    date_format(from_utc_timestamp(scored_at, 'Asia/Singapore'), 'd MMM yyyy HH:mm'), ' SGT') AS line FROM d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, concat('No forecast for today yet; this is the plan for ', date_format(target_date, 'EEEE, d MMMM yyyy'), '.')
  FROM d CROSS JOIN today WHERE d.target_date < today.sgt_today
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, concat('Tiers: High ', n_high, ', Medium ', n_medium, ', Low ', n_low, ', Not rated ', n_not_rated,
    CASE WHEN n_no_forecast > 0 THEN concat(', No forecast ', n_no_forecast) ELSE '' END, '.') FROM d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, concat('Medium means heightened care on a Moderate-heat day, not an alert.',
    CASE WHEN n_medium_high_heat = 1 THEN ' One Medium area has High heat and is in the lower third for vulnerability.'
         WHEN n_medium_high_heat > 1 THEN concat(' ', n_medium_high_heat, ' Medium areas have High heat and are in the lower third for vulnerability.')
         ELSE '' END) FROM d WHERE n_medium > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 5, concat(n_high + n_medium, ' areas are High or Medium: the top 10 are in the first table, the other ',
    n_high + n_medium - 10, ' in the table under it.') FROM d WHERE n_high + n_medium > 10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 6, concat(CASE WHEN size(nr) = 1 THEN nr[0] ELSE concat(array_join(slice(nr, 1, size(nr) - 1), ', '), ' and ', element_at(nr, -1)) END, CASE WHEN size(nr) = 1 THEN ' has High heat but is' ELSE ' have High heat but are' END,
    ' Not rated: no HDB blocks to rate, so only the heat level is shown.') FROM d WHERE size(nr) > 0
)
ORDER BY k

datasets.name: ds_area_map
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT target_date, planning_area, heat_level, tier, tier_rank, tier_sentence, reason, actions, scored_at
  FROM area_heat_risk WHERE target_date = (SELECT max(target_date) FROM area_heat_risk)
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT r.planning_area, initcap(r.planning_area) AS area, r.tier, r.heat_level, r.tier_sentence,
    coalesce(CASE WHEN r.reason IN ('many residents aged 75+; a high share of residents aged 75+', 'a high share of residents aged 75+; many residents aged 75+') THEN 'many residents aged 75+, who are a high share of its residents' ELSE r.reason END, '') AS reason, coalesce(r.actions, '') AS actions,
    coalesce(v.rental_1_2_room, 0) AS rental_1_2_room,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY CASE r.tier WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 WHEN 'Not rated' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, r.tier_rank) AS briefing_order
  FROM latest r LEFT JOIN area_vulnerability v ON v.planning_area = r.planning_area
)
SELECT o.area, o.tier, o.tier_sentence, o.rental_1_2_room, greatest(o.rental_1_2_room, 1) AS marker_size,
  st_y(st_centroid(m.geometry)) AS lat, st_x(st_centroid(m.geometry)) AS lon
FROM ordered o JOIN planning_area_map m ON m.planning_area = o.planning_area

datasets.name: ds_top_areas
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (

  FROM area_heat_risk WHERE target_date = (SELECT max(target_date) FROM area_heat_risk)
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT r.planning_area, initcap(r.planning_area) AS area, r.tier, r.heat_level, r.tier_sentence,
    coalesce(CASE WHEN r.reason IN ('many residents aged 75+; a high share of residents aged 75+', 'a high share of residents aged 75+; many residents aged 75+') THEN 'many residents aged 75+, who are a high share of its residents' ELSE r.reason END, '') AS reason, coalesce(r.actions, '') AS actions,
    coalesce(v.rental_1_2_room, 0) AS rental_1_2_room,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY CASE r.tier WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 WHEN 'Not rated' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, r.tier_rank) AS briefing_order
  FROM latest r LEFT JOIN area_vulnerability v ON v.planning_area = r.planning_area

datasets.name: ds_more_areas
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT target_date, planning_area, heat_level, tier, tier_rank, tier_sentence, reason, actions, scored_at
  FROM area_heat_risk WHERE target_date = (SELECT max(target_date) FROM area_heat_risk)
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT r.planning_area, initcap(r.planning_area) AS area, r.tier, r.heat_level, r.tier_sentence,
    coalesce(CASE WHEN r.reason IN ('many residents aged 75+; a high share of residents aged 75+', 'a high share of residents aged 75+; many residents aged 75+') THEN 'many residents aged 75+, who are a high share of its residents' ELSE r.reason END, '') AS reason, coalesce(r.actions, '') AS actions,
    coalesce(v.rental_1_2_room, 0) AS rental_1_2_room,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY CASE r.tier WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 WHEN 'Not rated' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, r.tier_rank) AS briefing_order
  FROM latest r LEFT JOIN area_vulnerability v ON v.planning_area = r.planning_area
)
SELECT briefing_order, area, tier, tier_sentence, reason, rental_1_2_room, actions FROM ordered WHERE briefing_order > 10 AND tier IN ('High', 'Medium')
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, 'None: every High or Medium area is in the top 10', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ordered WHERE briefing_order > 10 AND tier IN ('High', 'Medium'))
ORDER BY briefing_order

datasets.name: ds_trend
queryLines:
SELECT sgt_date, heat_category, heat_order, count(DISTINCT station_id) AS stations
FROM observed_heat_daily
GROUP BY sgt_date, heat_category, heat_order
ORDER BY sgt_date, heat_order

datasets.name: ds_area_facts
queryLines:
SELECT planning_area, initcap(third) AS third, CASE WHEN reason IN ('many residents aged 75+; a high share of residents aged 75+', 'a high share of residents aged 75+; many residents aged 75+') THEN 'many residents aged 75+, who are a high share of its residents' ELSE reason END AS reason, aged_75_plus, rental_1_2_room,
  hdb_dwelling_units_confirmed, CASE WHEN small_hdb THEN 'too few flats to measure' ELSE concat(format_number(100 * refuge_beyond_400m, 0), '%') END AS refuge_beyond,
  CASE WHEN small_hdb THEN 'too few flats to measure' ELSE concat(format_number(100 * park_beyond_400m, 0), '%') END AS park_beyond, coalesce(neutral_components, '') AS held_neutral
FROM area_vulnerability

datasets.name: ds_blocks
queryLines:
SELECT planning_area, priority, concat(blk_no, ' ', street) AS block, rental_1_2_room, total_dwelling_units,
  refuge_main_name, CAST(round(refuge_main_m) AS INT) AS refuge_m,
  CASE WHEN refuge_within_400m THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS refuge_400m,
  park_main_name, CAST(round(park_main_m) AS INT) AS park_m,
  CASE WHEN park_within_400m THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS park_400m,
  CASE WHEN confirmed THEN '' ELSE 'coordinate from a tenant record' END AS note
FROM block_vulnerability
ORDER BY planning_area, priority

datasets.name: ds_points
queryLines:
SELECT planning_area, lat, lon,
  CASE WHEN refuge_within_400m THEN 'Block within 400 m of a refuge' ELSE 'Block beyond 400 m of a refuge' END AS point_type,
  concat(blk_no, ' ', street) AS label, greatest(rental_1_2_room, 1) AS marker_size,
  concat('priority ', CAST(priority AS STRING), '; 1-2 room rental flats ', CAST(rental_1_2_room AS STRING)) AS detail
FROM block_vulnerability
UNION ALL
SELECT planning_area, lat, lon, 'Refuge' AS point_type, name AS label, 30 AS marker_size, refuge_type AS detail
FROM refuge_layer

datasets.name: ds_weights
queryLines:
SELECT component, sub_index, weight, direction, small_area_rule, reason_phrase, review_status
FROM score_weights
ORDER BY sort_order

datasets.name: ds_actions
queryLines:
SELECT tier, actions, review_status
FROM tier_actions
ORDER BY CASE tier WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

frame.title: Planning areas by tier (dot size: 1-2 room rental flats; grey: not rated)

lines:
### How to read this

Each dot is a planning area, coloured by its tier: the forecast heat level for the day (NEA's Low, Moderate or High) crossed with how vulnerable the area is. Grey areas have no HDB blocks to rate and show the heat level only. The About page has the full rule.

Heat is forecast per planning area; blocks rank vulnerability only, never heat.

**Blocks to call first.** Open the **Blocks** page and pick the area: it lists the blocks with the most 1-2 room rental flats first, then those farthest from a refuge, with the nearest refuge and park. CoolCheck holds no personal data: match the blocks against your own client list.

Actions are a proposal, not yet reviewed by a practitioner. Not official advice.

frame.title: Blocks (size: 1-2 room rental flats) and refuges in the area

lines:
### What if a refuge were added here?
Reserved for the what-if refuge result (window B's `what_if_add_refuge`, Saturday). Not built yet.

**What a tier means.** Each planning area's tier crosses the forecast heat level for the day (NEA's heat-stress categories: Low, Moderate, High) with how vulnerable the area is, its third among the 32 rated areas:

| Forecast heat (NEA) / vulnerability | Lower third | Middle third | Upper third |
|---|---|---|---|
| Low | Low | Low | Low |
| Moderate | Low | Medium | Medium |
| High | Medium | High | High |

Heat is forecast per planning area, from its nearest WBGT station; blocks rank vulnerability only, never heat. The forecast's probability only orders areas inside a tier and is never shown.

**How vulnerability is measured.** Seven measures, each turned into a percentile among the rated areas (higher means more vulnerable) and weighted as in the table below: residents aged 75+ and their share of residents; 1-2 room rental flats; a small hot-month rise in 1-2 room electricity use (may indicate less air-con use); HDB flats beyond 400 m of a refuge; refuges per 1,000 residents aged 65+; HDB flats beyond 400 m of a park. A share or a rate over fewer than 1,000 people or flats is held at the middle (0.5); counts keep their value. The top 11 areas are the upper third, the next 11 the middle, the last 10 the lower. Areas without HDB blocks are not rated and show the heat level only.

**Limits.** The weights are a judgement, not fitted (there is no open outcome data to fit them to), and like the actions they are not yet reviewed by a practitioner. The Active Ageing Centre list is partial (93 of about 223), so distances overstate the gap where centres are missing. Distances are straight lines, not walking routes. Not official advice. CoolCheck holds no personal data.

**Sources.**
